{{Top|leg}}
'''Fort Praji''' was a fort that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. It was originally known as the '''Kalandar Installation''', but during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], it was renamed in honor of [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Collin Praji]].
